title: Smart Procurement ERP Logging System
summary: A document-to-ERP prototype for turning bills, receipts and invoices into structured procurement records with confidence-based review gates.
boundary: Independent functional prototype, with completed development and ERP integration tested against Odoo references.
problem: Logging procurement documents into enterprise ERP systems involves repetitive manual reading and data entry. The prototype explores a connected workflow from document ingestion and extraction to review and ERP integration.
contribution: Independent prototype development spanning document ingestion, multimodal extraction, backend workflow design and ERP adapter integration.

workflow.title: Receive documents
workflow.detail: Upload APIs, email inbox watchers and external payloads.

workflow.title: Apply ingestion controls
workflow.detail: Hash deduplication, antivirus scanning and quarantine.

workflow.title: Extract document structure
workflow.detail: PaddleOCR and an 8-bit quantized 8B vision-language model.

workflow.title: Evaluate and review
workflow.detail: Deterministic fallback filters, confidence scoring and manual review gates.

workflow.title: Integrate with an ERP
workflow.detail: A ProcurementERP port and adapters; tested against Odoo references.

architecture.title: API and validation
architecture.detail: Python, FastAPI and Pydantic form the backend and validation layer.

architecture.title: Document intelligence
architecture.detail: PaddleOCR is paired with an 8-bit quantized 8B VLM for multimodal layout extraction.

architecture.title: Persistence and retrieval
architecture.detail: PostgreSQL combines pgvector with full-text search. MinIO/S3 object storage holds document assets.

architecture.title: Workflow and integration
architecture.detail: Temporal workflows coordinate processing. The ProcurementERP port separates the workflow from target-specific ERP adapters.

decisions.title: Separate extraction from acceptance
decisions.detail: Model output is checked with confidence scoring and deterministic backend fallback filters. Unverified or low-confidence extractions go through human review gates.

decisions.title: Make the ERP boundary explicit
decisions.detail: The adapter pattern keeps target-specific ERP communication behind the ProcurementERP port. Odoo references were used for integration testing.

decisions.title: Combine OCR with visual-language extraction
decisions.detail: PaddleOCR is paired with an 8-bit quantized 8B VLM for multimodal layout extraction. The model configuration is explicit so future evaluation can be tied to a reproducible setup.

result: A functional prototype with completed development and reference-based ERP integration testing. Extraction quality, review rate, processing latency and cost per document remain unpublished in this case study.
evidence: This public case study documents the workflow and implementation choices. A source repository, demonstration link and reproducible benchmark are not linked yet.

title: Script Change Management
eyebrow: AI-assisted test maintenance / Sanitized employer work
summary: AI-assisted orchestration for maintaining automated test scripts as application UI and logic change across regression cycles.
boundary: Sanitized overview of confidential employer work. Client identities, proprietary code, test inventories and internal implementation artifacts are omitted.
problem: Application UI and logic changes can break large inventories of automated tests during quarterly or yearly regression runs. Investigating those breakages and updating scripts creates recurring maintenance work.
contribution: Backend development focused on orchestration logic and pipeline development, using custom Python scripts and LangChain as the decision framework for synchronous orchestration.

workflow.title: Detect a broken script
workflow.detail: A script breakage triggers the maintenance workflow.

workflow.title: Correlate defect reports
workflow.detail: The Auto Defect Management system supplies confirmed reports as application-change signals.

workflow.title: Orchestrate a repair
workflow.detail: Custom Python and LangChain coordinate the synchronous maintenance workflow.

workflow.title: Update the test code
workflow.detail: The workflow produces script changes intended to address the breakage.

architecture.title: Decision and orchestration layer
architecture.detail: Custom Python scripts use LangChain for decision-making within a synchronous orchestration pipeline.

architecture.title: Defect workflow bridge
architecture.detail: The pipeline connects with Auto Defect Management to use confirmed reports as change signals for test maintenance.

architecture.title: Tracing and observability
architecture.detail: LangSmith provides LLM tracing, alongside OpenTelemetry for observability.

architecture.title: Development tooling
architecture.detail: GitHub Copilot supports development alongside the Python and LangChain implementation.

decisions.title: Connect maintenance to diagnostic context
decisions.detail: The script workflow consumes confirmed reports from the defect-management integration rather than treating a broken script as an isolated event.

decisions.title: Keep the execution model explicit
decisions.detail: Custom Python scripts and LangChain coordinate implementation through synchronous orchestration.

decisions.title: Trace the orchestration
decisions.detail: LangSmith tracing and OpenTelemetry observability accompany the decision and orchestration pipeline.

result: An internal system in development, with backend orchestration and pipeline development as the documented contribution. Repair acceptance criteria, production rollout and measured operating results are not published in this sanitized overview.
evidence: Employer code and internal artifacts are confidential under NDA. This case study provides a sanitized technical explanation without client data or proprietary implementation material.

title: Auto Defect Management System
role: Developer · Evidence collection, duplicate checks and logging
summary: An integration workflow that collects automated-test failure evidence, checks existing Jira issues and structures new defect reports.
boundary: Sanitized overview of confidential employer work. Client identities, issue contents, proprietary code and internal test artifacts are omitted.
problem: Automated test runs can generate repeated failures that require manual investigation and duplicate bug reports. The system addresses the work between observing a failed test and producing a useful issue for triage.
contribution: Hands-on development of the evidence collection mechanism, automated duplicate-checking logic, and the script-healing and logging framework connecting the test and issue-management workflows.

workflow.title: Capture an execution failure
workflow.detail: Collect failures from Eggplant automation runs.

workflow.title: Gather evidence
workflow.detail: Collect diagnostic context for the failed execution.

workflow.title: Check existing issues
workflow.detail: Compare against existing Jira tickets before reporting a new issue.

workflow.title: Structure a new report
workflow.detail: Format a clean Jira ticket for a genuinely new issue.

architecture.title: Test execution boundary
architecture.detail: Eggplant supplies automated-test execution failures to the integration workflow.

architecture.title: Evidence and duplicate checks
architecture.detail: Diagnostic evidence collection and automated checks against existing Jira tickets support the triage workflow. The public summary does not specify the duplicate-matching algorithm.

architecture.title: Jira logging and issue tracking
architecture.detail: The system connects automated-test logging with Jira issue tracking.

architecture.title: Script-maintenance bridge
architecture.detail: The logging and healing framework connects this workflow to Script Change Management. The two case studies describe distinct responsibilities within the connected work.

decisions.title: Check before reporting
decisions.detail: Existing Jira tickets are checked before a new defect report is created, with the aim of avoiding duplicate issue clutter.

decisions.title: Collect context at the failure boundary
decisions.detail: Evidence collection is part of the integration workflow so that new issue reports can carry diagnostic context.

decisions.title: Connect reporting to script maintenance
decisions.detail: The healing and logging framework provides a bridge from defect-management work to the connected Script Change Management system.

result: A deployed internal integration tool connecting test execution, diagnostic evidence and Jira reporting. The disclosed contribution covers evidence collection, duplicate checks and the healing/logging framework; deployment scale and measured business impact are not included.
evidence: Employer code, ticket examples and test artifacts remain confidential under NDA. The public evidence is this sanitized workflow and contribution summary.
